object.attr: stakeholder: as for MELLON-EDIT-SRS-194; `depth` 1 gives the top-level sections. Built after 0.3.0. Worded so that it is clear where counting starts (review Q22).
object.description: When an outline call gives `depth` n, the MCP server shall list only objects within n levels, counting a top-level object, or a sub-object of the given root object, as level 1.
